title: Loft wardrobes under the slope, with a window seat
summary: A whole loft room: a run of wardrobes stepping down under the roof slope, a long window seat full of cupboards that turns the corner, a TV unit and a separate dressing table.
intro: A new loft room with the roof coming down along one wall. Under the slope there is now a run of three units: a full height wardrobe with double hanging, an angled unit with shelves over four drawers, and a small angled unit that keeps the loft hatch behind its door. Under the window, three seat boxes with cupboards run along the wall and turn the corner, with a TV unit at the end. Every unit was drawn in CabinetOS, my own app, and built from its printed cut lists. The doors are shaker style, made as a 12 mm MDF base with a 6 mm border glued on, and everything is left bare, ready for the decorator.

facts.value: 1000 and 740 mm wide, down the slope

steps.title: A level base first
steps.text: A timber base frame on the floor, levelled before anything stands on it, then the first carcass goes on top: the full height wardrobe next to the bedroom door.

image.alt: The first wardrobe carcass standing on a base frame next to the bedroom door, under the roof slope

steps.title: Boards cut
steps.text: The MDF cut to the cut lists printed from CabinetOS, one sheet per unit, stacked against the wall ready to go together.

image.alt: Cut MDF panels leaning against the wall

steps.title: Checked on paper
steps.text: Every printed sheet carries the sizes checked against the drawing, like a shelf at 962 = 964 less 2. Each one gets a tick as it is cut.

image.alt: A printed CabinetOS sheet with a size check, 964 less 2, ticked

steps.title: Down the slope
steps.text: Next to the wardrobe goes the angled unit: 1980 mm high on the left, coming down to 1340 on the right to follow the roof.

image.alt: The wardrobe carcass and the angled carcass beside it, its top cut to the slope

steps.title: Round the loft hatch
steps.text: At the low end a small angled unit, 1290 down to 820. Its back is cut round the loft hatch, so the hatch is still there behind the door.

image.alt: The small angled carcass at the low end of the slope, with the loft hatch inside it

steps.title: Seat boxes under the window
steps.text: Three seat boxes along the window wall and round the corner, each 1069 wide, 400 high and 500 deep, with a long top over them.

image.alt: Low seat carcasses along the wall under the window

steps.title: What goes inside
steps.text: Double hanging in the wardrobe. In the angled unit, two shelves over four drawers on undermount runners, with a dust shelf on top of the drawers.

image.alt: Inside the angled unit: shelves over four drawers, and the loft hatch in the small unit beside it

steps.title: Shaker doors on
steps.text: Five shaker doors across the run, the ones on the angled units cut to follow the slope. Black bar handles.

image.alt: The finished run of shaker doors stepping down under the roof

steps.title: The window seat
steps.text: Shaker cupboard doors along the whole seat, and a TV unit at the end with the sockets inside it.

image.alt: The finished window seat with shaker cupboard doors, turning the corner

steps.title: And a dressing table
steps.text: A separate dressing table with a drawer, on timber legs, under the other slope by the radiator.

image.alt: A dressing table with a drawer on timber legs, in front of the radiator

model3d.title: The wardrobes in 3D
model3d.text: The run under the slope drawn in 3D to the sizes in my CabinetOS project: the 1039 mm wardrobe, the 1000 mm angled unit coming down from 1980 to 1340, and the 740 mm unit from 1290 to 820, 2797 mm in all. The rails, the loft hatch, the door and the ceiling are drawn from the photos. Open the doors to see the hanging, the drawers and the loft hatch, or take it apart unit by unit.
